title: FuriusGacha
description: A Gacha Plugin made by  Furiusfighter213.(Beta)
body:
# FuriusGachaPlus (Beta)

The most advanced Gacha system plugin for Minecraft servers!

## Features

- **Complete Gacha System** - Full-featured gacha/loot box mechanics with spinning animations
- **Pity System** - Soft pity and hard pity mechanics to guarantee rewards
- **Multiple Rarity Tiers** - Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic, and Exclusive rarities
- **Banner System** - Create limited-time banners with featured items and rate-ups
- **Collection Book** - Players can track all items they've obtained
- **Shop System** - Sell tokens, spins, and premium currency
- **Vault Integration** - Full economy support with Vault
- **PlaceholderAPI Support** - Display player stats anywhere
- **Customizable Rewards** - Items, commands, permissions, and more
- **Stunning Animations** - Smooth GUI spinning animations with particles and sounds
- **Multi-language Support** - Built-in language system

## Requirements

- Java 17+
- Spigot, Paper, Purpur, or any Bukkit fork (1.21+)
- Vault (optional, for economy features)
- PlaceholderAPI (optional)

## Commands

- `/gacha` - Open the main gacha menu
- `/gacha spin` - Perform a single spin
- `/gacha spin10` - Perform 10 spins
- `/gacha banner` - View available banners
- `/gacha collection` - View your collection
- `/gacha shop` - Open the token shop
- `/gacha reload` - Reload configuration (admin)

## Permissions

- `furiusgacha.use` - Access the gacha system
- `furiusgacha.admin` - Admin commands
- `furiusgacha.spin` - Perform spins
- `furiusgacha.shop` - Access shop
- `furiusgacha.collection` - View collection
